There's a meditative quality to repetitive, precise motions—eyeliner wings require a steadiness that can anchor your whole nervous system. You're not just applying makeup; you're setting the terms for how you enter the world. If it feels grounding and centering, then it's doing exactly what a good ritual should. The world can wait those few extra minutes.
